east_leg.note: East leg present: short stub east of Montgomery at the bottom edge. North line y~7121 from the block corner (8652,7120) east to the plate's trimmed edge at x~8750. Only ~49 px (y 7121-7170) of its width is on the plate/region; the bottom edge cuts it, so the south line is not visible. Centre assumed at north line + 45 px (60 ft like the west leg) = y~7166, i.e. essentially on the plate edge; centre y is an estimate.

reads.note: Montgomery Road: west line (lot fronts) through ~(8550,7080) and ~(8594,7000); east line coincides with the plate trim through ~(8719,7000) and (8652,7120); ~110 px wide; centreline x = 8656 - 0.56*(y-7000). West leg ('AVE.', lots 1700-1730): north line y~7080, '60' ft width printed in the street, south line below the region/plate edge, centreline y~7125. East leg north line is jogged ~41 px south of the west leg's north line (7121 vs 7080); along Montgomery the two centreline meets are ~47 px apart (east leg further SW/down). Lines at y~7110 and ~7140 crossing both legs and Montgomery are pipes/sewers, not street edges.

east_leg.note: Present. Strip of street east of Montgomery from its north line y~7120 (where the plate cut steps from Montgomery's diagonal east line to horizontal at x~8652) down to the plate bottom edge y~7170, and east to the plate's east edge at x~8750. Only ~50 px of its width is on the plate; the south line is off-plate. Centre assumes the same ~60 ft (90 px) width as the west leg, which puts the centreline at y~7165, essentially on the plate edge. A heavy line at y~7140 crossing Montgomery into this strip is the sewer (12" SEWER), not a street edge.

reads.note: Montgomery: west property line through (8555,7075)/(8590,7000), east line = plate cut (~8724 at y 7000), about 115-120 px wide, centreline x~8657 at y 7000, ~8593 at y 7120. West leg (printed 'AVE.', 1700-1730, width '60' printed in street): north property line y~7078 (lot line); the solid line at y~7110 below the house numbers runs straight across Newton's mouth, so it is a curb/sidewalk line, not the property line; dashed 6" W. pipe at y~7122. South line is below the plate edge (7170); centreline = 7078 + 45 = 7123 (estimate). Jog: north lines 7078 (west) vs 7120 (east) = ~42 px in y, ~45 px along Montgomery. If the west leg's north line were instead taken as the 7110 line the jog would shrink to ~10 px, so the size of the offset is uncertain.
